metadata.title: Gauge Rigidity and Holonomy Classification of Time-Scaled Intertwining Cocycles on Hilbert Bundles
metadata.abstract: We extend the discrete gauge rigidity of time-scaled intertwining cocycles to operator networks over a connected manifold M and classify the holonomy that the continuous setting admits. For dissipative semigroups $S_x(t)=e^{-tA_x}$ linked by transport operators $K_\gamma S_{\gamma(0)}(t)=S_{\gamma(1)}(\lambda(\gamma)t)K_\gamma$ along paths $\gamma$, we prove that the scaling field carries no monodromy: $\lambda(x,y)=\tau(x)/\tau(y)$ for a continuous positive function $\tau$, unique up to a multiplicative constant, with multiplicativity forced by the intertwining relation rather than assumed. For regular cocycles the transport defines a bounded operator connection on a Hilbert bundle over M; the holonomy of a closed loop is confined to the commutant of the generator and decomposes into spectral sectors, on each of which it is adiabatic (Berry-Wilczek-Zee) transport twisted by an independent commutant-valued sector potential; for flat unitary cocycles the holonomy is classified by unitary representations of $\pi_1(M)$ in the commutant. An explicit rotating network over $S^1$ exhibits holonomy equal to the parity operator while the Berry connection one-form of every level vanishes identically: the monodromy is carried by $\mathbb{Z}_2$ orientation classes of Moebius eigenline bundles.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 研究 Hilbert 丛上带时间缩放的半群交织输运，声称缩放场具有全局势而无单值化障碍，并以生成元交换子中的表示描述平坦酉输运的完整回路信息。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出局部 Berry 联络形式为零但整体回路输运非平凡的 Möbius 特征线例子。
analysis.limitations: 结论依赖规则性、平坦性或酉性等不同假设，不能把全部分类结论用于一般输运。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 对联络与谱几何有启发，主要服务算子丛和数学物理方向。
